effects: Takes exactly `assets` USDC from the signer and sends it to the vault (enter: safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)).
Mints vault shares (kpk_USDC_YieldV2) to `onBehalf`. The number is previewDeposit(assets) at the current price, and the call sets no minimum.
Accrues interest first, which can mint fee shares to the fee recipients. This sets the price but moves none of the signer's assets.
formats.shown: Deposit 0.1 USDC for the onBehalf address, with a constant share ticker and the share recipient.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted is not shown, and the function sets no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. There is no minShares parameter. Case 0 minted 0.1 kpk_USDC_YieldV2 to 0xdead (signer null).
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. The descriptor could add a note that shares follow the current share price.

findings.title: deposit: the 'Share ticker' constant KPK_USDC_Yield differs from the on-chain symbol kpk_USDC_YieldV2.
findings.evidence: descriptor metadata.constants.vaultTicker = "KPK_USDC_Yield". Case 0 mined: the share token symbol is "kpk_USDC_YieldV2". The older vault token 0x9178... is "kpk_USDC_Yield_Morpho".
findings.fix: Set vaultTicker to the on-chain symbol kpk_USDC_YieldV2, or drop the raw constant field.

cases.notes: The screen shows the 0.1 USDC out exactly. The shares go to 0xdead (signer null), and the screen shows that recipient. The reader rightly saw that the signer gets nothing.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns shares from `onBehalf`. The number is previewWithdraw(assets), rounded up, and the call sets no maximum.
Sends exactly `assets` USDC from the vault to `receiver`.
When msg.sender != onBehalf, uses up the share allowance that onBehalf gave the signer, by the number of shares burned.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly 191.8 USDC to the receiver, with the owner of the shares shown.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned from the owner is not shown, and the function sets no maximum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(...)`, then exit: `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. Case 2: the signer's 190.925295880850178894 kpk_USDC_YieldV2 went out and is not on the screen.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata, because the share count comes from the stored price. Only the Owner field states whose shares are burned.

cases.notes: The 191.8 USDC in to the signer is shown exactly. The 190.93 shares burned are not shown. The reader knew the position shrinks but did not know the amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` vault shares from `onBehalf`, using up the signer's allowance when msg.sender != onBehalf.
Sends USDC to `receiver`. The amount is previewRedeem(shares) at the current price, and the call sets no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem 4982.23 KPK_USDC_Yield shares to the receiver, with the owner shown. Nothing on the screen names the asset received.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never names USDC as the asset paid out to the receiver.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets)`. The descriptor's redeem fields cover only shares, receiver and onBehalf. Case 3: the signer received 5001.014701 USDC, and the reader wrote 'probably USDC, not shown'.
findings.fix: Add a field like mint has, {"label":"Receive asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}, and say 'Redeem {shares} for USDC to {receiver}' in the interpolatedIntent.

findings.title: redeem: the amount of USDC received is not shown, and the function sets no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares);` with no minAssets parameter. Case 3: 5001.014701 USDC came in.

cases.notes: The 4982.228... shares out are shown exactly. For the USDC in, the screen gives neither the asset nor the amount. The reader guessed USDC from the name.

effects: Takes USDC from the signer. The amount is previewMint(shares), rounded up, and the call sets no maximum.
formats.shown: Mint 0.9 KPK_USDC_Yield for the onBehalf address. A 'Deposit asset: USDC' field gives no amount.

findings.title: mint: the amount of USDC taken from the signer is not shown, and the function sets no maximum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol mint: `uint256 assets = previewMint(shares); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. enter: safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, ...). Case 1: 0.923875 USDC left the signer. The screen shows only 'Deposit asset: USDC'.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. A label such as 'Pays USDC at current share price' would help.

findings.title: mint: the intent 'Mint' does not say the signer pays USDC.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint intent "Mint", interpolatedIntent "Mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}". Case 1: 0.923875 USDC went out from the signer.
findings.fix: Use intent 'Deposit USDC' and interpolatedIntent 'Deposit USDC to mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}'.

cases.notes: The reader knew USDC leaves but not how much (0.923875). The 0.9 shares went to 0xdead (signer null), and the screen shows that recipient.
